# SOP-P3-L1-02 Product changeover - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-006, MM-P3-L1-IH03, SB-1027

Purpose
This procedure defines the required actions, responsibilities, and records for a product changeover on the Hot Forge line to ensure safe, repeatable, and documented transition between billet lots and product families. It applies to the equipment listed above and references control and maintenance requirements in ECN-2026-006, MM-P3-L1-IH03, and SB-1027.

Background and rationale
Changeovers on the Hot Forge line present risks to product quality and equipment integrity if heater, lubrication, or blanking/sizing systems are not set and verified. The Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) must be confirmed to the target billet temperature to meet material flow and grain refinement objectives. Hydraulic press lubrication must use the approved lubricant to prevent premature wear and preserve die life. This SOP standardizes critical verification points and the records required for production traceability and audit.

Preconditions
1. Production leader has approved the upcoming changeover via the line scheduling system and confirmed billet lot release.  
2. All operators and technicians assigned to the changeover are trained and authorized for Hot Forge changeovers.  
3. Lockout/tagout clearance has been obtained where required for access to guarding and tooling, in accordance with plant LOTO policy.  
4. Required materials and consumables are staged: replacement dies, die lubricant, blanking inserts, and the lubricant CFW-LUB-927 for EQ-P3-L1-HP01.  
5. Maintenance has confirmed no active work orders prohibit operation of EQ-P3-L1-IH03, EQ-P3-L1-HP01, or EQ-P3-L1-SB02.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
1. Heat-resistant gloves rated for forging operations.  
2. Face shield and safety glasses.  
3. Hearing protection for operators on the line.  
4. Flame-resistant clothing in accordance with plant PPE policy.  
5. Cut-resistant gloves for die handling.

Procedure (numbered steps)
1. Prepare for shutdown and isolate product flow. Rationale: prevents mixed-lot billets entering the heater or press during changeover and maintains traceability. Example: confirm upstream material feed is secured and tagged. Record: material lot tag attached to feed conveyor and noted on the changeover checklist.

2. Verify and document heater setpoint and actual condition for EQ-P3-L1-IH03. Rationale: ensuring target billet temperature before forging preserves metallurgical properties. Action: confirm that the operator interface and the physical thermometer/readout indicate the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 1260 °C. Record: print or photograph the heater readout and log the confirmation on the changeover checklist; cross-reference to MM-P3-L1-IH03 for calibration trace.

3. Inspect and install tooling on EQ-P3-L1-HP01 and EQ-P3-L1-SB02. Rationale: proper die seating reduces the risk of flash defects and die damage. Action: verify dies are free of foreign material, correctly oriented, and torqued per die carrier documentation (see SB-1027 for die clamping guidance). Record: tooling inspection form with signatures.

4. Confirm lubricant and lubrication points for EQ-P3-L1-HP01. Rationale: correct lubricant prevents scuffing and protects hydraulic components. Action: verify the lubricant part number for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01) is CFW-LUB-927 and that the reservoir contains the specified product. Record: attach supplier batch label and lot to the changeover checklist and record reservoir top-up action.

5. Run dry cycle checks without billet feed. Rationale: validate mechanical movements, blanking sequence, and safety interlocks prior to introducing heated material. Action: execute cycle at low stroke/pilot settings as per operator panel and confirm correct sequence for EQ-P3-L1-HP01 and EQ-P3-L1-SB02. Record: dry cycle log entry and any fault codes; reference ECN-2026-006 if sequence changes are required.

6. Introduce a single trial billet and perform initial production verification. Rationale: confirm process stability, dimensional accuracy, and surface condition before full production. Action: feed one billet heated in EQ-P3-L1-IH03 at the confirmed target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 1260 °C and run through press and sizer. Inspect the first forged part for critical dimensions and surface condition. Record: attach first-part inspection report to the batch record.

7. Quality confirmation and approval to run. Rationale: prevents production of nonconforming product. Action: Quality signs the changeover checklist approving parts for full production only after visual and dimensional acceptance. Record: signed changeover checklist and signed first-part report.

8. Monitor initial production and document stability. Rationale: short-term monitoring captures drift or intermittent issues. Action: log process observations and any deviations on the shift run log. If deviations occur, stop the line and follow nonconformance protocol. Record: run log entries and any corrective action records with references to ECN-2026-006 for required engineering changes.

Examples of common changeover issues and responses
- Heater drift from target temperature: reference MM-P3-L1-IH03 and notify Maintenance; suspend feeding until resolved.  
- Die misalignment producing flash variation: stop press, reseat dies per SB-1027, and repeat steps 3–6.  
- Lubricant mismatch detected: quarantine supply, replace with CFW-LUB-927, and document supplier lot.

Records to keep
1. Changeover checklist signed by operator, supervisor, and Quality.  
2. Heater readout confirmation and calibration reference to MM-P3-L1-IH03.  
3. First-part inspection report and sample photograph.  
4. Lubricant batch label and confirmation that CFW-LUB-927 was installed into EQ-P3-L1-HP01.  
5. Dry cycle and initial run logs, including any fault codes and corrective actions.  
6. Any ECN-2026-006 documentation invoked during the changeover.

Responsibilities
1. Operator: execute steps, complete checklist, and perform first-part inspection.  
2. Maintenance: verify EQ-P3-L1-IH03 calibration and support heater issues, per MM-P3-L1-IH03.  
3. Quality: approve first-part acceptability and sign off the changeover checklist.  
4. Production supervisor: confirm preconditions and authorize resumption of full production.

Sign-off
Operator name and signature: ____________________  
Supervisor name and signature: ____________________  
Quality name and signature: ____________________  

Revision history and references
- See ECN-2026-006 for engineering changes affecting sequence or tooling.  
- See MM-P3-L1-IH03 for maintenance and calibration procedures for EQ-P3-L1-IH03.  
- See SB-1027 for die handling and blanking/sizing guidance.
